Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior, then give relevant validation.

Every change must meet [the manifesto](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/MANIFESTO.md)
and [the contribution checks](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
Keep them in sync if a requirement changes, and state current evidence and
remaining goals separately.

Declare scope: bounded component, integrated continuing behavior, or infrastructure.
Name the applicable equilibrium boundaries, simpler control and preservation gates.
Infrastructure can explain applicability without an unrelated whole-brain test.
Follow the [behavior-over-time evidence contract](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-and-evidence-for-behavior-over-time)
and link the applicable owner coordinated by
[#109](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/issues/109#coherent-behavior-over-time).

For sequence claims, identify the continuing learned context and temporal
organization, then report retained/absent/perturbed-context comparisons with
matched exposure and relevant recovery or counterfactual tests. Sequential output,
sensory feedback, trace, memory and efference are permitted. Next-event accuracy
or self-feeding alone is component evidence. Distinguish numerical residual from
musical surprise and sequence quality. State the actual solve boundary: held
trace in `Brain.act` is not a joint future-trajectory solve. No phrase module or
whole-song-at-once output is required; no answers, phase or arrangement may be
hidden in an adapter.

For a mechanism, learning, memory or resolved-default change, follow
[the preservation review](https://github.com/muellerberndt/cadence/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#preserve-the-capable-foundation)
and include:

- The demonstrated limitation and why the simplest existing System 1 is insufficient.
- The affected local boundaries and update law. Every addition must operate
  through local agreement repair in the same coupled global equilibrium.
- The simpler control, measured improvement on the declared limitation, and
  information/work used, plus the animal/human functional hypothesis being tested.
  Biological names alone do not establish functionality.
- Released/candidate fresh acquisition and acquired-checkpoint continuation,
  distinguishing historical settings, unchanged public arguments and opt-in genes.
- Retained recall, associations, context, reward revision, actual-action ownership,
  private imagination, pending checkpoint continuation, refusals and total work.
- The original acceptance gates, failed comparisons and remaining limits.

Do not promote a mechanism or default while a required demonstrated capability
regresses. For unrelated changes, omit the inapplicable items.
